semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company manufactures seamless stainless tubes and pipes used in semiconductor applications, but is not primarily a semiconductor supplier.
summary: BOTONG Precision Technology (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd specializes in the production of seamless stainless tubes and pipes that are utilized in various industries, including semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are made from high-quality materials and undergo rigorous testing to ensure compliance with international standards.
capabilities: Manufacturing seamless stainless tubes and pipes for semiconductor applications
Production of austenitic and duplex stainless steel materials
Quality assurance through 100% PMI, eddy current, and hydrostatic testing
technical_expertise: Material science for stainless steel and nickel-alloy production

regional_presence.USA: The company supplies products to the USA market.
regional_presence.Japan: The company has a presence in the Japanese market.
regional_presence.Korea: The company serves the Korean market.
regional_presence.Southeast Asia: The company distributes products across Southeast Asia.
regional_presence.Middle-east: The company has established a market presence in the Middle-east.
